content: निगमनम् .²1 Quotation of a word from the Veda or the word so quoted. .²2 (In logic) The conclusion in a syllogism, a deduction (the fifth member of the five-membered Indian syllogism); निगमनं च प्रतिज्ञाया हेतोश्च पुनर्वचनम् <ls>ŚB. on MS. 7. 1. 12</ls>. .²3 Going in or into. .²4 End, conclusion; इत्येवमुपक्रम्य निगमने इदं श्रूयते . <ls>ŚB. on MS. 3. 3. 2</ls>.
